name: World Literature and History Joint Major
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below

sections.note: Students are moreover required to satisfy the prerequisites of all courses (upper and lower division) that are taken within this joint major and should consult regularly with the program advisors regarding course selection.

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 18 units of 100 and 200-level History courses
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least six lower division history units before enrolling in 300 division work and nine lower division history units before enrolling in 400 division work.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a total of 15 units.

sections.note:
History
World Literature
Students complete a total of 15 units, including.
one 100-level WL Writing course
*Students may count one 2nd year language course (3 units) toward their lower division WL units.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete 24 units of 300 and 400-level history courses, of which 12 must be in 400-level.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least one course from each group shown below.

requirements.title: Students complete a minimum total of 20 upper division WL units
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: 12 additional upper division WL units, of which at least four must be taken at the 400-level.

sections.note:
History
Global/Comparative courses that are also included in another group may only be counted towards fulfilling the upper division course requirements for one group.
Group 4 - Global/Comparative
Group 1 - Africa, Asia, Middle East
Group 2 - The Americas
Group 3 - Europe
Students in history joint major programs have the option of taking concentrations to enhance their programs.
World Literature
Concentration in British History and Irish History
Concentration in Early Modern World History
Concentration in Middle Eastern and Islamic History
Students complete a minimum total of 20 upper division WL units including both of.
